name: Temple Gardens
summary: Temple Gardens gather the waters and bridges at Darnassus's heart, with the city bank on their main island. The Temple of the Moon borders them to the south, and a glowing tree portal carries travelers to Teldrassil's base.

sections.title: Heart of the Elven Capital
sections.body: Water and wooden bridges cross the center of Darnassus, linking the Temple Gardens' islets to the Cenarion Enclave in the north, the terraces to the east, and the Temple of the Moon to the south. Night elves tend the flowing waters and foliage, making a quiet place of rest for travelers and priestesses.

sections.title: Gateway to Teldrassil
sections.body: The main island holds Darnassus's central vault and bank. On the western bank, a massive glowing pink tree portal carries travelers through the boughs to Rut'theran Village at Teldrassil's base. From there, the coastal docks and flight paths connect the World Tree to other destinations.

faq.q: What is the glowing pink portal in the gardens?
faq.answer: The glowing tree portal on the gardens' western edge carries travelers between Teldrassil's crown and its base. It takes them to Rut'theran Village, where ships and hippogryphs connect the night elves to darkshore and the wider world.

faq.q: Where is the Darnassus bank located?
faq.answer: Darnassus's main bank occupies an open elven pavilion on the Temple Gardens' largest central island.

faq.q: Why are they called the Temple Gardens?
faq.answer: The gardens take their name from the Temple of the Moon, which borders them to the south.

faq.q: Which districts connect to the Temple Gardens?
faq.answer: Bridges cross the water from the Temple Gardens to the Cenarion Enclave in the north, the Craftsmen's, Warrior's, and Tradesmen's Terraces to the east, and the Temple of the Moon to the south.

angles.text: As a night elf, you find the gardens where wilderness and civic architecture meet, a place for quiet reflection amid Darnassus's daily affairs.
As an Alliance visitor arriving by ship, you pass through the Rut'theran portal to reach the city's tranquil waters and the rest of Darnassus.
